＜Decode (Lv.4 or lower w/[Aqua]/[Sea Animal] in any trait or w/[TB] trait)＞ (When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than in battle, you may play 1 specified Digimon card from its digivolution cards without paying the cost.)

text_sections.text: ＜Decode (Lv.4 or lower w/[Aqua]/[Sea Animal] in any trait or w/[TB] trait)＞ (When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than in battle, you may play 1 specified Digimon card without paying the cost.)

qa.answer:
Yes, both have to be XX.
For example, "1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [CS] trait or that is yellow or black" means either "1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [CS] trait" or "1 level 4 or lower Digimon card that is yellow or black." In both cases, the card must be level 4 or lower.
